# Demo B composes its keyboard host policy

## Context and problem

This is the already-planned keyboard-host phase of #15614. At dev `d7e91ec544`, `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBWorkspace.mjs` remains 3,440 lines after the gesture phase. Its keyboard routing, target enumeration, preview and directional-focus policy form a coherent block of approximately 360 lines inside the composition owner. The aim is a smaller, readable host with unchanged behavior, not another command implementation.

## Architectural reality and prescription

The Engine's `src/dashboard/dock/interaction/KeyboardCommands.mjs` already owns the cycle and terminal machine. Demo B owns the policy connecting it to live windows, documents, previews and announcements. Prescription checked: `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBCrossWindowGesture.mjs` — the existing state-free registered prototype mixin is the matching composition mechanism; moving this policy into Engine KeyboardCommands would promote demo-specific window names and three-host assumptions.

Create sibling `DemoBKeyboardHost.mjs` as a registered `Neo.core.Base` mixin. Extract these existing host methods: `announceKeyboardOutcome`, `onDockHostKeyDown`, `resolveFocusedDockItem`, `resolveDockWorkspaceId`, `enumerateKeyboardTargets`, `setKeyboardTargetHighlight`, `commitKeyboardTransfer`, `focusNamedWindow`, `focusDockWorkspaceWindow`. Preserve their public/wrappable host entry points. Methods needing Demo B's static IDs/grammar use small host facades passing those values to the extracted implementation, as the gesture phase already does; do not import the host back into the mixin.

Keep the command factory call, listener registration, command instance, origin-window field, highlight generation, maps, pane references and destruction on the host. Internal cross-calls must resolve current host methods. There is no additional controller instance, event listener, state owner or lifecycle.

The earlier TopologyLibrary candidate is rejected for this behavior-preserving phase: its cloned reads and refused invalid writes change the plain holder's contract. Transient libraries or mirrored collection state would add complexity. The parent retains the larger host/lifecycle and perspective work.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The nine-method keyboard host policy is extracted into the sibling module; DemoBWorkspace gets smaller and the new module remains below the parent's 1,000-line target. Necessary static-ID facades stay in the host.
- [ ] Public method wrappers and construction-time callbacks still observe methods replaced after construction; no collaborator instance or host state is duplicated.
- [ ] Existing DemoBWorkspace, TourRunner and DockKeyboardCommands unit coverage passes, with targeted new boundary controls only where the extraction creates an otherwise unwitnessed seam; full unit suite passes.
- [ ] Native DemoBKeyboardDetachNL journeys pass: real popup detach, cycle/highlight/Escape with zero mutation, popup-origin return and truthful focus announcements. Existing cross-window/third-claimant/tear-out/perspective regression witnesses remain green.
- [ ] No changes to Engine keyboard/Group/gesture protocol behavior, model schemas, persistence, window acquisition policy or host lifecycle. Full JSDoc identifies the new module. The standard docs generator does not include examples, so no unrelated generator or hierarchy expansion is required.

## Scope and avoided traps

No TopologyLibrary adoption, Workspace superclass swap, new controller, new keyboard grammar, new window behavior, or automatic persistence. This leaf does not close #15614 or certify its final 1,500-line target; remaining host/lifecycle decomposition stays there. The keyboard phase is independent of that ownership mapping and can proceed without changing it.

Decision Record impact: aligned with the existing composition boundary of `neomjs/neo#adr:docking-design`; no amendment.
Structure-map gate: N/A, existing Body example role; sibling-file-lift beside the gesture mixin.
Ownership: Sophie, immediate implementation of the current owned decomposition stream; not offered as an unclaimed contributor leaf.
